import zipfile, os, shutil
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    sheet_xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
    styles_xml = z.read('xl/styles.xml')

# --- worksheet ---
root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
dim = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
col = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
col.set('width', '13')
col.set('customWidth', '1')
col.set('min', '8')
col.set('max', '8')

sheetData = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
for row in sheetData.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    c = ET.SubElement(row, f'{{{NS}}}c')
    c.set('r', f'H{r}')
    if r == 1:
        c.set('s', '1')
        c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
        t_el = ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS}}}t')
        t_el.text = 'Profit Margin (%)'
    else:
        c.set('s', '3')
        f_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
        f_el.text = f'G{r}/E{r}'
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v')

new_sheet = ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode')

# --- styles ---
sroot = ET.fromstring(styles_xml)
numfmts = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numfmt = ET.SubElement(numfmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
numfmt.set('numFmtId', '164')
numfmt.set('formatCode', '0.0%')
numfmts.set('count', '1')

cellxfs = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
for k, v in [('numFmtId', '164'), ('fontId', '0'), ('fillId', '0'), ('borderId', '0'),
             ('pivotButton', '0'), ('quotePrefix', '0'), ('xfId', '0')]:
    xf.set(k, v)
cellxfs.set('count', '4')

new_styles = ET.tostring(sroot, encoding='unicode')

# --- rebuild zip ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = new_sheet.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = new_styles.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('done')
